Container.Name: LambData
Container.Overview: Self-hosted MariaDB control plane with a web console. Create databases with their own users and passwords, keep commit-style checkpoints you can roll back to, create a database from a SQLite file or SQL dump, mirror other MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL databases, and serve a Data API, App Auth, Realtime, Functions and Storage from the same container. First start: open the container's log (Docker tab, click the LambData icon, choose Logs) and copy the one-time setup token printed there; the setup wizard asks for it before it creates the first admin. Upgrading from KilnDB: keep the existing appdata folder mapped to /data and back it up first. Formerly KilnDB.
Container.Requires: Unraid 7.2 or newer is required for native per-container Tailscale integration.

Config.Name: LambData Data
Config.Description: Everything LambData keeps: MariaDB, metadata, the encryption key (master.key), checkpoints, storage objects, functions, logs and Tailscale state. When upgrading from KilnDB, point this at the existing KilnDB folder (for example /mnt/user/appdata/kilndb).

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: LambData web console and API port.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Leave at 0. Session cookies already become Secure on their own whenever the console is opened over HTTPS (Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale Serve or an HTTPS reverse proxy). Set to 1 only if every visit uses HTTPS: with 1, signing in over plain http no longer works.

Config.Name: Access Policy Recovery
Config.Description: Recovery only. Leave empty. If the Network access policy locks you out, set this to open and restart the container: LambData resets the policy to allow every connection and keeps it open while the variable is set. Clear it and restart afterwards.
